# Opus (vendored)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Project | libopus, the reference Opus codec (RFC 6716) |
| Upstream | <https://opus-codec.org/>, <https://gitlab.xiph.org/xiph/opus> |
| Tag | `v1.6.1` (release tarball) |
| Archive | <https://downloads.xiph.org/releases/opus/opus-1.6.1.tar.gz>, SHA-256 `6ffcb593207be92584df15b32466ed64bbec99109f007c82205f0194572411a1` (10,472,813 bytes; matches Xiph's `SHA256SUMS.txt`) |
| License | BSD-3-Clause (`COPYING`, copied verbatim). Opus is also covered by the royalty-free patent licences listed at <https://opus-codec.org/license/>. |
| Files | `COPYING`; the sources the upstream build lists in `CELT_SOURCES`, `SILK_SOURCES`, `SILK_SOURCES_FLOAT`, `OPUS_SOURCES` and `OPUS_SOURCES_FLOAT` (`celt_sources.mk`, `silk_sources.mk`, `opus_sources.mk`); the headers of `include/`, `celt/`, `silk/`, `silk/float/` and `src/`. No assembly, intrinsics, DNN or test files. All are byte-identical to the archive above (`.gitattributes` keeps them out of end-of-line conversion) |
| Modifications | none |

Use: Opus decoding (and, in the tests, encoding) for `src/alchemy/darwin/media/media_codecs.cpp`. `cmake/darwin/media_codecs.cmake` builds the static library `alchemy_opus` (floating point, `OPUS_BUILD`, `USE_ALLOCA`).

To update: download the new release from the upstream above, check its published hash, copy the same set of files with the vendoring rules above, and update this file, the hashes and `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
